up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records where the enzyme is a Cytochrome P450. For each record, provide the metabolic conversion, pathway key, and organism. Additionally, include the canonical SMILES structure and preferred name of the substrate compound associated with the metabolism record.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md_sub.pref_name AS substrate_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key,
  m.organism
FROM metabolism m
JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md_sub.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE m.enzyme_name LIKE '%Cytochrome P450%'
LIMIT 200;
